queries.database_meta: SELECT key, value FROM database_meta ORDER BY key
queries.source:
SELECT sr.id AS source_record_id, sr.display_name, sm.source_file_id, sm.projection_note_id,
    sm.status FROM source_records sr JOIN source_materializations sm ON sm.source_record_id=sr.id
    WHERE sr.id=?
queries.placements:
SELECT nbp.block_id, nbp.id AS note_placement_id, cp.id AS canvas_placement_id,
    cp.frame_id, json_extract(nb.metadata, '$.source_page_index') AS source_page_index,
    nbp.id=cp.id AS exact_match,
    cp.id=('canvas-placement:' || nbp.id) AS prefixed_match
    FROM note_block_placements nbp JOIN note_blocks nb ON nb.id=nbp.block_id
    JOIN content_mounts cm ON cm.target_kind='note_block' AND cm.target_id=nbp.block_id AND cm.note_id=nbp.note_id
    JOIN canvas_placements cp ON cp.object_id=cm.object_id AND cp.note_id=nbp.note_id
    WHERE nbp.note_id=? ORDER BY nbp.order_index
queries.frame_count: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM page_frame_extensions WHERE note_id=?
